'''Advanced Flesh Camouflage Kits''' were advanced model of [[disguise kit]] available during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook" />
